text:
rachel: Starting a small PR to add a concise migration checklist for Dedicated -> Private. Want to keep it one A4 page: steps, CLI snippets, and a short billing note. Draft: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/5033

miguel: I'll grab the CLI snippet section. Suggest two quick commands: drain + reassign. Example: `redwoodctl pool drain --pool=old-pool --timeout=300` then `redwoodctl tenant assign --tenant=acme --pool=new-private-pool`

samir: Add an explicit step for KMS key rewrap & cert rotation. For Private we require the `kms_key_id` in the private config and new certs within 24h post-migration. I'll drop a short sentence.

rachel: Can we include a tiny Terraform example showing how to change pool type? Keep it minimal.

miguel: Minimal TF snippet:
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "acme" {
  name = "acme"
  reserved_gpus = 2
  autoscale { min = 1 max = 4 metric = "p95_latency_ms" target = 150 }
}
# to private: update resource type and add kms_key_id
```

samir: QA checklist note from SRE: run a staged drain on a non-prod tenant to validate session draining and fallback routing. Include command and expected observation: RPS drops, active sessions -> 0 within grace period.

qa-bot: Quick links added: staging runbook, billing FAQ. Spellcheck passed. Table-lint: warning about SLA row wording.

rachel: I'll reword the SLA sentence to avoid ambiguous numbers. Plan: merge public checklist by Thu; gated on-prem steps will be a separate ticket and callout. Miguel/Samir please ack so I can squash and merge.

miguel: ack :thumbsup:

samir: ack :thumbsup:
